rationale: Flags subjects with create access to Pods, a privilege-escalation path that CIS 5.1.4 says to restrict (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags subjects with access to Secrets, which CIS 5.1.2 says should be limited to reduce privilege-escalation risk (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags bindings to the cluster-admin role, which CIS 5.1.1 says should only be used where required (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags NetworkPolicies whose podSelector matches no deployment, a stale cross-object reference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags NetworkPolicy ingress/egress peer podSelectors that match no deployment, a broken reference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags Services whose selector matches no deployment, a broken reference between objects (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags ServiceMonitors whose selectors match no Service, a stale reference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags pods using the default service account instead of a dedicated one, which weakens least-privilege identity isolation (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags deployments with no dnsConfig options set, an opinionated DNS-setting policy that is not one of the four smell categories (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags env vars that reference a Secret or ConfigMap not included in the deployment, a broken reference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags raw secrets placed in environment variables, which exposes secret values (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags Services of forbidden types such as NodePort or LoadBalancer, which exposes workloads outside the cluster (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags pods sharing the host's network namespace, which breaks network isolation (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags pods sharing the host's process namespace, which breaks process isolation (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags HorizontalPodAutoscalers with minReplicas below three, which reduces availability and fault tolerance (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags containers using the latest tag or no tag, an unpinned image reference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags liveness probes pointing at a port the container does not expose, so the probe misbehaves at runtime (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags deployments with fewer than three replicas, which lowers availability and fault tolerance (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags deployment selectors that do not match the pod template labels, an inconsistent reference within the object (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags multi-replica deployments without pod anti-affinity, so replicas may share a node and hurt availability (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags containers without a liveness probe, so hung containers are not restarted (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags deployments with no node affinity, an opinionated scheduling-placement policy outside the four categories (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags containers running without a read-only root filesystem, which weakens container isolation (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags containers without a readiness probe, so traffic may reach pods that are not ready (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags deployments not using a rolling update strategy, risking service disruption during updates (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags pods referencing a service account that does not exist, a broken reference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags deployment-like objects not selected by any NetworkPolicy, leaving them open to unsafe traffic (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags PodDisruptionBudgets whose minAvailable always blocks pod disruptions, harming rollout and node-drain availability (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags PodDisruptionBudgets that do not set unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy, which affects eviction behaviour of unhealthy pods (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags deployments reading secrets from env vars, since CIS 5.4.1 prefers secrets mounted as files (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags objects without a valid owner email annotation, an organisational metadata policy rather than a smell category (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags objects without an owner label, an organisational metadata policy rather than a smell category (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags deployment-like objects without a restart policy of Always or OnFailure, reducing fault tolerance (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags containers not set to runAsNonRoot, a privilege issue (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags resources that fail validation against the Kubernetes API schema (via kubeconform), a manifest-correctness issue (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags containers mounting sensitive host directories such as /etc or /proc, which breaks host isolation (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags YAML keys that are not in alphabetical order, a pure style preference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags containers without CPU requests and limits, a resource-allocation gap (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags containers without memory requests and limits, a resource-allocation gap (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags resources deployed to the default namespace, citing CIS 5.7.1 and 5.7.4 on namespace boundaries (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Flags wildcards in Role or ClusterRole rules, which can grant inadvertent access, per CIS 5.1.3 (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
Checks that pods set ephemeral-storage requests and limits, a resource-allocation control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that pullPolicy is Always so imagePullSecrets are always validated, an image-pull setting (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that an explicit non-latest image tag is used, an image-version pinning rule (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that pods set resource requests and limits, a resource-allocation control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that the security context sets a read-only root filesystem, a container-isolation control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that the security context sets a valid UID and GID, a privilege control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that CronJobs configure a deadline, which governs runtime behaviour of missed or late runs (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that CronJobs have a valid RestartPolicy, a runtime-reliability setting (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks for podAntiAffinity that keeps replicas off the same node, an availability control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that every Deployment is targeted by a PodDisruptionBudget, an availability control during disruptions (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that selector labels match template metadata labels, a reference-consistency rule (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that a Deployment has multiple replicas (default minimum 2), an availability control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that Deployments targeted by a Service use RollingUpdate, avoiding downtime during updates (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that an HPA has multiple replicas (default minimum 2), an availability control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that each NetworkPolicy targets at least one Pod, otherwise it is a stale reference (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that each Pod is targeted by a NetworkPolicy, a network-isolation control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that Pods have safe probe configurations, a runtime-reliability control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that readiness and liveness probes are not identical, a probe-reliability rule (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that each Service targets a Pod, otherwise it is a dangling reference (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that the Service type is not NodePort, which exposes the workload on every node (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that a StatefulSet names an existing headless Service, a reference-consistency rule (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
